title: IntelLite
description: IntelLite is a SkyrimNet companion SKSE plugin. It comes with 5 actions - Fetch Person, Deliver Message, Meet Later, Assassinate and Cancel All - and the character-bio awareness submodule that lets an NPC know its own IntelLite meetings, contracts and messages. The four targeted actions can also be issued from the in-game panel. More info on github.
author: jykej
changelog:
First public release.
- Five native SkyrimNet actions: Fetch Person, Deliver Message, Meet Later, Assassinate and Cancel All.
- MagelightUI panel and consent card.
- Package travel with off-screen deadlines, door and gate staging, and a simulation fallback.
- World-wide NPC index, fuzzy name resolution and an editorid blacklist.
- SkyrimNet awareness submodule.
- One DLL for SE and AE, tested on 1.6.1170. SE 1.5.97 and other AE / 1.7.x builds are untested
